### God’s Plans for You Started Before You Were Born
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-may-30-2017.html
Passage: Jeremiah 1:5
Points:
- Living a purposeful life requires maximizing the gifts and strengths God provided.
- God's intentions for your life began before your birth, when He formed you in the womb.
- Understanding how God uniquely wired you clarifies how He desires to use you.
- Your spiritual gifts, heart, abilities, personality, and experiences reveal your divine calling.

### Jeremiah the Weeping Prophet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jeremiah-weeping-prophet
Passage: Jeremiah 1:1-8
Points:
- God appointed Jeremiah to call Judah to repentance during a time of moral decline.
- Though Jeremiah was young and reluctant, his prophetic mission was ordained in eternity past.
- God forming Jeremiah in the womb affirms the sanctity of human life from conception.
- Jeremiah's pre-birth appointment shows that God sovereignly ordains a vocation for every believer.

### Before I Knew You, I Formed You
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/before-i-knew-you-i-formed-you-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Jeremiah 1:5
Points:
- Insecurities and perceived inadequacies do not cancel God's sovereign calling on a life.
- God intimately knows every detail and season of our lives from before conception.
- Being set apart by God means believers will and should live differently from the surrounding culture.
- While Jeremiah's prophetic role was unique, all believers share the calling to make disciples.

### What’s the Plan?
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-october-17-2011.html
Passage: Jeremiah 1:5
Points:
- True life success comes from discovering and pursuing God’s customized plan rather than worldly approval.
- God designs a specific path for each individual that accounts for strengths, limitations, and life seasons.
- The Lord faithfully supplies the necessary resources and strength whenever He calls someone to act.
- Knowing God's purpose requires persistent prayer, studying His Word, and obedient next steps.
